# Atrial Fibrillation

This folder groups the specific clinical quality indicators and safety outcomes used to monitor atrial fibrillation care within the Danish healthcare system. It covers core treatment metrics like anticoagulation persistence (Indikator 4a) and the incidence of severe bleeding (Indikator 11) or heart failure (Indikator 15) following a new diagnosis. Additionally, it defines the specific clinical conditions—such as gastrointestinal, pulmonary, and urinary tract bleeding—that constitute the standardized severe bleeding endpoints for these national quality reports.

## Pages

- [[gastrointestinal-bloedning|gastrointestinal blødning]] — Defines gastrointestinal bleeding as one of the four strict categories of severe bleeding used to evaluate anticoagulation safety in Indicator 7.
- [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] — Tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who develop severe bleeding within one year of their diagnosis.
- [[indikator-15|Indikator 15]] — Measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who develop heart failure within one year, serving as a key long-term outcome metric.
- [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]] — Monitors the persistence of indicated anticoagulation therapy one, two, and five years after an atrial fibrillation diagnosis to prevent thromboembolic complications.
- [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]] — A supplementary mortality indicator that tracks the death rate among prevalent patients living with atrial fibrillation during a given reporting period.
- [[lungebloedning|lungeblødning]] — Defines pulmonary bleeding as a core component of the severe bleeding outcome variable used in national safety monitoring.
- [[supplerende-analyser-7|Supplerende analyser 7]] — Broadens the scope of bleeding surveillance by tracking severe bleeding incidents specifically among prevalent, rather than newly diagnosed, atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[supplerende-indikator-hjertesvigt-efter-atrieflimren|"Supplerende indikator: Hjertesvigt efter atrieflimren"]] — A supplementary metric evaluating the development of heart failure as a complication following a new atrial fibrillation diagnosis to support long-term care assessments.
- [[urinvejsbloedning|urinvejsblødning]] — Defines urinary tract bleeding as one of the four specific severe bleeding types tracked to monitor the hemorrhagic risks of anticoagulation therapy.
